title: This week: what the tile becomes at each size
question: Each size gets a designed layout instead of being refused. Which layouts should This week offer? Good alternatives stay selectable in the tile's settings; you pick defaults per size.

options.label: Just a link
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: A plain doorway to the calendar with a count: the quietest form, for a Home that is already busy.
options.viewport: This week at 1 × 1, 2 × 1, 1 × 2 and 2 × 2 on a 2-column Home.
options.risk: Judged at phone size; check the 1 × 1 reads at arm's length.

options.label: Agenda
options.lineage: a tile drawn for its size
options.thesis: The list grows with the tile: one next thing at 1 × 1, two or three at 2 × 1, the whole week when tall.
